title: Fix TreeSitter C# chunking key mismatch
description:
P0: `TreeSitterChunkingService.cs` has `ExtensionToLanguage[".cs"] = "CSharp"` but `ChunkableTypes["c_sharp"]` — `OrdinalIgnoreCase` doesn't bridge the underscore. On any `.cs` file where Roslyn chunking fails, the TreeSitter fallback silently uses generic chunking (no language-specific declaration boundaries) with no diagnostic log distinguishing the two.

Scope:
- Rename `"c_sharp"` → `"CSharp"` in `ChunkableTypes` dictionary
- Or remove `.cs`/`"CSharp"` from TreeSitter entirely if Roslyn is the only intended path
- Add a `LogWarning` when Roslyn chunking fails (the missing diagnostic is the real problem)

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-2-20260702.md §2, council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 6-seat council audit synthesis. Source-Grounded Archivist rated at 95% confidence. Retrieval Specialist noted real-world impact is low (Roslyn is primary chunker) but missing diagnostic is the real issue.
